name: Dream11 (Dream Sports)
tagline: India's fantasy sports leader, forced into a free-to-play sports-engagement pivot
facts: FY25 ₹6,759 cr (-15% YoY), net loss ₹479 cr
Paid contests stopped 22 Aug 2025; free-to-play now

strategy.label: Mission
strategy.text: Make sports better for fans: from paid fantasy contests to a free, AI-personalised second screen for sports.

strategy.label: Vision
strategy.text: Global sports engagement platform: content, live scores, watchalongs, community and social contests across sports and markets.

strategy.label: Ban response
strategy.text: Complied overnight without suing, kept 250M users, no layoffs, cut sponsorships, split group into eight startup-mode units (Dec 2025).

strategy.label: Key bets
strategy.text: Ad-supported free fantasy in India plus 11 overseas markets; Dream Money for gold, SIPs and broking; FanCode streaming expansion.

strategy.label: Moat
strategy.text: Brand synonymous with fantasy cricket, 250M accounts, deep sports data and a large war chest from 2021 raise.

strategy.label: Your view
strategy.text: Can a 250M-user audience built on cash prizes be monetised through ads and fintech, or was the prize the product?

customers.pain: Want stakes and bragging rights during matches without spending money
customers.why: Familiar team-building game, social leagues with friends, now free with no deposit risk

customers.pain: Lost cash prizes; free contests feel low-stakes and less thrilling
customers.why: Habit, deep stats and player tools; the alternatives are offshore betting apps they distrust

customers.who: Cricket fans in US, UK, UAE, Australia
customers.pain: Few fantasy products built around cricket in their country
customers.why: Free-to-play Dream11 launched in 11 markets (Oct 2025) with familiar formats

customers.who: Swiggy, Tata Neu, Astrotalk and similar consumer brands
customers.pain: Need to reach engaged sports audiences during live matches at scale
customers.why: Huge live-match attention, sports-context targeting, sponsorship of free contests and watchalongs

customers.pain: Need distribution and monetisation for live sports commentary
customers.why: Creator-led watchalongs reach 100K+ viewers in minutes on Dream11 surfaces

products.name: Watchalongs

portfolio.key_metrics: Match-day DAU, contests per user, ad impressions per session, D30 retention
portfolio.guardrails: No cash-like rewards breaching PROGA; ad load vs session time; churn

products.name: Cricbuzz stake

portfolio.key_metrics: Subscribers, streaming hours, rights cost per hour, ARPU
portfolio.guardrails: Rights spend within budget; buffering/QoS; subscriber churn

products.name: Digital gold
products.desc: Buy gold from ₹10 via Augmont partnership

products.name: SIPs and FDs

portfolio.guardrails: SEBI/RBI compliance, mis-selling complaints, speculation-like behaviour

rows.who_uses: Fans playing free contests and watching watchalongs
rows.how: In-app ads, sponsored contests, branded watchalongs on match days

rows.who_uses: Fans watching niche leagues and cricket
rows.how: Match/tour passes, subscriptions, ads, merch discontinued

rows.who_uses: Young retail investors from Dream11 base

rows.how: ~15–20% platform rake on entry fees; ended 22 Aug 2025

bullets.label: Revenue mix
bullets.text: Pre-ban ~95% from contest rake; now ads, sponsorships, FanCode and early fintech, all sub-scale (est.).

bullets.label: Users vs payers
bullets.text: 250M registered, previously a minority paying entry fees; now users are free, advertisers pay.

bullets.label: Unit economics
bullets.text: Rake gave high take-rate per user; ad ARPU is a small fraction, so costs and sponsorships were slashed.

bullets.label: Growth levers
bullets.text: Global free fantasy, AI personalisation, creator watchalongs, cross-sell to Dream Money, FanCode in new markets.

bullets.label: Cash cushion
bullets.text: Runs on reserves from $840M 2021 raise; GST disputes over ₹28,000 cr remain an overhang.

friction: Free contests lack the thrill that cash stakes provided
Rewards must avoid anything resembling money under PROGA
Ad-heavy match screens dilute fast team-building flow
Fintech cross-sell feels unrelated to sports intent
Users wary after abrupt wallet shutdown and withdrawals

competitors.label: Fantasy (pre-ban)
competitors.text: MPL, My11Circle, MyTeam11; all exited cash contests

competitors.label: Sports media
competitors.text: JioHotstar, Cricbuzz, ESPNcricinfo, SonyLIV for live-match attention

competitors.label: Fintech
competitors.text: Zerodha, Groww, Angel One, Jar for investing

competitors.label: Grey market
competitors.text: Offshore betting apps capturing ex-RMG users illegally

competitors.label: Edge
competitors.text: Largest fantasy audience and brand, cash reserves, strong sports data

competitors.label: Risk
competitors.text: Ad ARPU far below rake; Supreme Court outcome; GST liabilities
